name: Global Classroom
shortDescription: Students can connect with other learners from all over the world
header: Learn from Home in a Global Classroom
description: Online classes allow students from all around the world to learn from each other online. Activities can include message board activities, Flipgrid, and video chat just to name a few.

name: Comfort of Home
shortDescription: Students can learn from the comfort of their own home.
description: Students no longer have to drive to class somewhere to take a foreign language class. This is extremely convenient for busy adults who have jobs, children, and significant others to factor into their busy lives.

name: integrate technology
shortDescription: Teachers can more easily integrate technology tools into their lessons
description: Technology allows students to demonstrate what they have learned in interesting and creative ways. For example, students can post a video of themselves speaking a foreign language rather than just doing a bland written homework assignment.
